```sql
WITH caddo_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Caddo County' AND border_type ILIKE 'county'
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Area(ST_Clip(r.rast, true, c.geometry::geometry, true))) * 100.0 / ST_Area(c.geometry::geometry) AS percent_area_above_240
  FROM
    public.dem_us r
    CROSS JOIN caddo_county c
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    AND ST_ValueCount(r.rast, ST_Clip(r.rast, true, c.geometry::geometry, true), true, 240, true) > 0
)
SELECT percent_area_above_240 FROM elevation_analysis;
```
